purpose: Conformance vectors for the optional context_digest field in the decision_binding_ref preimage. context_digest = SHA-256(JCS(assembled_context)) binds the set of memories/documents/artifacts that fed a decision, without resolving attribution or steering -- only presence. Proposed by eriknewton (co-founder, trust-evidence-format) in A2A discussion#1734 (https://github.com/a2aproject/A2A/discussions/1734#discussioncomment-17896415).
reproduce_in_python:
import hashlib, json
def jcs(obj): return json.dumps(dict(sorted(obj.items())), separators=(',',':'), ensure_ascii=False)
context_digest = 'sha256:' + hashlib.sha256(jcs(assembled_context).encode()).hexdigest()
decision_binding_ref = 'sha256:' + hashlib.sha256(jcs(preimage).encode()).hexdigest()

context_dropped_artifact.note: context_full with strategy_actor_ranking.md silently dropped -- a memory that fed the real decision is missing from the presented set.

vectors.name: context_digest_present_recomputable
vectors.description: decision_binding_ref preimage carries context_digest (no policy_ref). Verifier holds context_full, recomputes SHA-256(JCS(context_full)) and finds it matches the embedded context_digest. Result: PASS.
vectors.rationale: context_digest in the preimage equals SHA-256(JCS(context_full)). The verifier recomputes over the presented context set and arrives at the same value -- confirming context_full was present in the input of this decision, without claiming it explains the outcome.

vectors.name: context_digest_and_policy_ref_combined
vectors.description: decision_binding_ref preimage carries both policy_ref and context_digest -- the four optional-field combinations (neither/policy_ref-only/context_digest-only/both) must all canonicalize deterministically. Result: PASS.
vectors.rationale: Both optional fields present, JCS lexicographic key order places context_digest before decision_at_ms/decision_id and policy_ref last -- deterministic regardless of insertion order in either implementation.

vectors.name: context_digest_backward_compat_absent
vectors.description: decision_binding_ref preimage with neither context_digest nor policy_ref -- identical to v1.0 Fixture B, unaffected by the extension. A verifier that does not know about context_digest still computes the same ref. Result: PASS.
vectors.rationale: Backward compatibility check: the extension is purely additive. This vector is byte-identical to v1.0's Fixture B and MUST produce the same decision_binding_ref.

vectors.name: context_set_mismatch_dropped_artifact
vectors.description: The preimage embeds context_digest computed over context_full. A verifier is presented context_dropped_artifact (the same set minus strategy_actor_ranking.md, silently omitted). The verifier recomputes SHA-256(JCS(presented_context)) and gets a different digest than the embedded context_digest. Result: FAIL (CONTEXT_SET_MISMATCH).
vectors.rationale: A dropped or substituted artifact from the context set changes SHA-256(JCS(assembled_context)). The verifier MUST reject rather than silently accept a partial or altered context set as if it were the one that actually fed the decision -- same fail-closed pattern as POLICY_SNAPSHOT_MISMATCH in policy-change-v1.
